fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Phone Status. 1. 'У меня' marks possession or condition in a very common everyday structure. 2. 'Разряжен' is a short-form passive adjective that describes the battery state. 3. 'Телефон' is one of the highest-priority survival words in modern daily life, so this sentence belongs in the standard set.

Strategic focus: Communication. 1. 'Отправляю' is the first person singular of 'отправлять'. 2. 'Вам' is the polite dative 'to you', which is a very useful social register. 3. 'Сообщение' covers messages, notices, and texts, making this a broadly useful everyday sentence.

Strategic focus: Written Messages. 1. 'Мне нужно' sets up the task as a necessity. 2. 'Написать' is the perfective infinitive, which suits a goal you want to finish. 3. 'Письмо' can mean a letter or an email depending on context, so this sentence stays useful across both older and newer communication habits.
